  EVIDENCE: The file `.claude/scripts/dispatch_workflow.py` at the PR head (84cdcbd) is the old version. It lacks `new_runs`, `_response_run_id`, `_read_run`. Its `dispatch` does not send `return_run_details`, does not use `matched_by`, does not handle `ambiguous`/`candidate_run_ids`. Its `_post_dispatch` returns None and does not send `return_run_details: true`. The tests at `tests/test_dispatch_workflow.py` load from `SCRIPT_PATH = REPO_ROOT / ".claude" / "scripts" / "dispatch_workflow.py"` (line 20), which resolves to the master copy. The new tests `test_uses_the_run_id_github_returned_even_when_a_newer_run_raced_in`, `test_response_id_stands_when_the_run_read_fails`, `test_response_without_a_usable_run_id_falls_back_to_polling`, `test_fallback_never_guesses_between_several_new_runs`, `test_post_dispatch_returns_the_response_object_or_none`, and `test_find_new_run_still_returns_the_newest_new_run` all reference functions and FakeGitHub features that only exist in the twin `workflow-templates/.claude/scripts/dispatch_workflow.py`. The modified existing test `test_returns_the_new_run_not_the_previous_one` asserts `result["matched_by"] == "new_run"` but the old master module never sets `matched_by`. The monkeypatched `dw.new_runs` in `test_poll_failure_after_the_post_reports_dispatched_true` and `test_main_keeps_dispatched_true_on_a_failed_poll` is ineffective because the old `dispatch` calls `find_new_run` (not `new_runs`), and the unhandled fallback produces a different error message than the test expects.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
